consequence.statement: Bumping the CI code-scanning action github/codeql-action has no operational consequence for operators running external-secrets.

assertion.statement: The project's CI tooling dependency github/codeql-action was bumped from 3.28.13 to 3.28.15; nothing in the evidence shows an effect on deployed external-secrets components.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: github/codeql-action is a GitHub Actions dependency of the project's CI, not shipped in the product; no subject family fits it.; change: Without a fitting subject family, the version bump 3.28.13 -> 3.28.15 cannot be typed as a change to the product.; applicability: A CI workflow dependency leaves nothing in a customer environment to check.
